text: Whales are mammals, not fish.
Increasing the temperature speeds up most chemical reactions.
Dogs bark when strangers approach.
A triangle has three sides.
Most birds can fly, but penguins cannot.
Metals expand when they are heated.
Not every child likes chocolate.
Every child does not like spinach; in fact, no child likes it.
There is one book that every student in the class has read.
Every student read a different book.
No doctor recommended any of the treatments.
Alice and Bob met in Berlin and decided to start a company together.
The three brothers lifted the piano together.
Each of the three brothers lifted the box alone.
Anna, Paul and Maria share an apartment in Vienna.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Employees who work more than forty hours per week are entitled to overtime pay.
The bridge is 340 meters long and at least 80 years old.
Fewer than ten people attended the meeting.
A tenant may terminate the lease with thirty days' written notice.
Only Sarah knew where the key was hidden.
Even the teacher failed the test.
Lisa wanted to visit Rome, but she went to Lisbon instead.
John also bought a ticket.
Cats usually sleep during the day.
The train is always late on Mondays.
Tom never drinks coffee after six in the evening.
If it had rained, the match would have been postponed.
If I were rich, I would buy a house by the sea.
Had the driver braked earlier, the accident would not have happened.
